name: respond-to-event
description: Responds to an Outlook meeting invitation: accepts, declines or tentatively accepts it, optionally with a comment, and tells the organiser unless sendResponse is false. The event id comes from microsoft-outlook__list-events.

response.description: How to respond to the invitation.

comment.description: Optional comment included with the response.

sendResponse.description: Whether to send the response to the organiser. Defaults to true.
